# tnt CLI specification

Canonical command-line contract of the `tnt` console script. The generated grammar inventory between the
markers below is owned by `cli-extended surface sync`; everything else is product-owned. The semantic review
catalog ([`cli-review.toml`](cli-review.toml)) currently has no reviewed cases; completing that review (AC-17) is
BACKLOG TNT-29.
The surface is declared in [`../pyproject.toml`](../pyproject.toml) (`[tool.cli-extended]`).

<!-- cli-extended-surface:start -->
## Generated CLI surface and semantic review

Executable: `tnt` via `tnt`; built-ins: `help`, `help <verb>`, `version`, `--help`, `--version`. Empty argv: shows help.

Surface schema: `7`; review catalog schema: `1`; library contract: `cli-extended` v1.

The manifest records registered syntax. The review catalog owns expected behavior, effects, rationale, and test references.
